Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer order for system optimization services.

id.description: Unique order identifier prefixed with M-GRID-

customerName.description: Full name of the purchasing customer.

customerEmail.description: Contact email address of the customer.

purchasedProducts.description: A summary or list of purchased products and quantities.

paymentAmount.description: The final price paid after discounts are applied.

status.description: Current fulfillment status of the order.

paymentMethod.description: The processing gateway utilized for this transaction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the order was created.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Main collection storing customer license optimization orders.
